subject implied from prior context (e.g. practitioners/devotees)

items.question: By what kind of names is that goddess always designated?
premises: That goddess is the object of designation.
The designation of her occurs always.
The names used are endowed with fame established by secondary meaning.
items.inference: Therefore that goddess is always reckoned by names whose renown derives from secondary meaning.
uncertainties: The agents of gaṇayanti are implied from the preceding context rather than named in this verse.
items.plain_english: They always designate her by names whose renown is established through secondary meaning.
